name: wakeflow
description: Unattended control loops for multi-window agent work.

interface.shortDescription: Unattended control loops for agent work
interface.longDescription: Wakeflow packages the complete control-workspace runtime as a Codex plugin: controller state roots, task packages, Design/Test intake, delivery envelopes, target result envelopes, review reducers, controller-return envelopes, progress templates, verification scripts, and controller/target skills. It prepares unattended workflows without secretly sending prompts or replacing controller judgment.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the current workspace with Wakeflow
